National Archives Catalog adapter, first written from the spec, is now rebuilt on real responses and verified with a live key.

- Rights: Restricted - Possibly and Undetermined are `unknown`; NARA's own wording and specific restrictions are kept.
- Dates keep year-only precision and "ca."; a lone start or end date now works (NARA only filters when both are sent).
- Photographer and mapmaker credits, places apart from subjects, record group and series, and an archival citation.
- `nara_extracted_text` returns machine OCR and partner transcriptions, labelled; search results carry record-group and material facets.
- Clear errors for a bad key, firewall-blocked queries and invalid filter values; placeholder file sizes left out.
- Long files show 25 media; downloads still reach all.
- New `download` command for the CLI. Cut-off HTML error pages (Internet Archive outage) are cleaned."}
